WHAT: Whisnap CLI used as transcription engine in production-studio/scripts/transcribe.ts

COMMAND: whisnap <audio_file> --json [--cloud]
OUTPUT FORMAT:
{
  "text": "full transcript",
  "words": [
    { "text": "Full", "startMs": 0, "endMs": 320 },
    { "text": " transcript", "startMs": 320, "endMs": 780 }
  ],
  "segments": [...]
}

KEY: Leading space preserved in word text (" transcript" not "transcript") — Remotion needs this for whitespace:pre rendering in TikTok-style captions

WHY: Ned's own product, already installed globally, word-level timestamps map directly to Remotion's Caption format — no Whisper.cpp install, no model download, no extra API

REMOTION MAPPING: scripts/transcribe.ts maps words[] directly to Caption[] objects for createTikTokStyleCaptions()

GOTCHA: --cloud flag available for better accuracy via Whisnap Cloud
